title: The rwb-source-data slice of RWB-E2-022 has no API shapes, no lists and no delivery columns in the source
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epic 2 Story Files v5/RWB E2 022 SMS and LINE dispatch through NSS and LINE OA v1.md (RWB-E2-022); FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3; TSD P1 Recovery data engine v3
section: 1 Story; 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria; 11 Data; 12 Contract; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: This story owns no legacy acceptance criterion and is written with new criteria only. No source gives the contact-point read or the failed-count operation a path, a request, an answer or an error set: the legacy interface was an in-process method (PartyApi.contactPoints, PartyApi.recordFailedContact, InteractionLedgerApi.updateDelivery) with no path and no status code, and TSD P1 T-A.1 lists API-P1-001 to API-P1-016, none of which reads a contact point or counts a failed contact. No source states the problem title of the 404 of an unknown contact point, the stored types of the two delivery columns, the three consent renderings of the answer, the channel to contact_type mapping, or the increment rule of the failed count. TSD P1 T3.8 no longer lists LOV-CHANNEL for P1 and lists no delivery-status list, so the channel and delivery values the answer needs are not owned by this service. The story fixes the shapes in ASM-B2-P1-016-2, the renderings in ASM-B2-P1-016-3, the mapping in ASM-B2-P1-016-4, the append-and-fold and the columns in ASM-B2-P1-016-5, the count rule in ASM-B2-P1-016-6 and the lists in ASM-B2-P1-016-7, and cites the placeholders at each point.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-022 section 12 declares POST /cases/{caseId}/messages of P6 and the five published Java interfaces, with PartyApi.contactPoints, PartyApi.recordFailedContact and InteractionLedgerApi.updateDelivery owned by P1; its sections 9 and 11 give the delivery values Sent, Delivered, Read, Failed and the fields DF-INT-028 delivery_status and DF-INT-029 external_ref but no column type. TSD P1 v3 T-A.1 lists API-P1-001 GET /admin/jobs to API-P1-016 POST /admin/data-contracts/{contractId}/publish and no contact-point or ledger operation; T3.5 restricts contact_point_ext.contact_type to PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS and keys it by contact_key with no person_key; T3.6 lists no interaction table; T3.8 lists no LOV-CHANNEL and no delivery-status list. FSD P1 v3 A2.1.3.2 gives the contact_point_ext fields and A2.2.2 gives DP02 as DAILY with expected_by 08:00 and no per-row date. Architecture v5 slide 11 gives the 2 s hop and the 5 s statement timeout.
owner_role: TechX API owner, with the data steward (RW-DATASTEW)
proposed: Publish the two operations and the ledger extension in the P1 API appendix as part of the RWB-P6-E2022-CON baseline, and confirm the two delivery column types, the consent renderings, the channel mapping, the count rule and the source of the two lists at the contract review; then close this row.
